markdown:
Drthaks are aquatic predators with long trailing fins that are rarely seen, clinging to coasts and estuaries where the high silt content makes them practically invisible to predators and prey alike. Some have been known to come inland, tracking their prey miles upriver before striking. The underwater environment alters the typical dischoran hunting behavior, with drthaks creating bubbles that implode to stun prey. **[Recall Knowledge - Beast](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 22 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 20 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17 [Drthak](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3268) **Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 140 **Perception** +15; no vision, sensitive echolocation ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 120 feet **Languages** **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +16, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +17, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +13 **Str** +4 **Dex** +5 **Con** +4 **Int** -3 **Wis** +3 **Cha** -1 **Deep Breath** The drthak can [hold its breath](/Rules.aspx?ID=2436) for about 2 hours.
**Sensitive Echolocation** The drthak can use its hearing as a [precise sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) with the listed range. If the drthak takes sonic damage beyond its resistance, its senses are overloaded and all creatures are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) from it for 1 round. --- **AC** 23 **Fort** +14 **Ref** +17 **Will** +11 **HP** 110 **Immunities** [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) **Auditory Hunter** **Trigger** A creature within 15 feet uses an [auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541) action; **Effect** The drthak Strides or [Swims](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) towards the creature. --- **Speed** 20 feet, swim 40 feet **Melee** jaws +16, **Damage** 2d8+4 piercing plus [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45) **Ranged** screech +17 ([range 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)), **Damage** 4d6 sonic plus resonant jaws **Bubble Burst** ([Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147), [Water](/Traits.aspx?ID=165)) **Requirement** The drthak is underwater; **Effect** The drthak uses sonic power to push aside water in a 30-foot emanation, which then collapses in a crushing torrent. All creatures in the area, other than the drthak, take 3d10 bludgeoning damage (DC 24 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). **Pull Under** The drthak can [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) at half Speed while it has a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) in its jaws, carrying the creature along with it. **Resonant Jaws** When the drthak misses a screech Strike against a creature [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) or [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) in its jaws, it deals that creature 2d6 sonic damage.
